subject: CAIQ control registry & evidence playbook for NimbusBank
messages:
From: Chris Nolan <security@nimbusbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ evidence request for Redwood Inference

Hi Mina,

We're starting the vendor security intake for Redwood ahead of our integration proof-of-concept. As part of NimbusBank's cloud security review we need a CAIQ mapping showing how Redwood's controls map to CSA/CCM categories and links to the supporting evidence. Specifically we need: 
- A completed CAIQ/CCM mapping spreadsheet (control -> owner -> evidence file/link)
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (latest) or SOC bridge
- Sample logs or access records demonstrating control operation (e.g., KMS access logs, infra audit logs)

Target timeline: initial artifact delivery by EOD 2026-07-20, gaps call week of 7/22 if needed.

Can you confirm owners and whether any controls will be marked as compensated or pending? Also let us know any NDAs or additional paperwork required for sensitive artifacts.

Thanks,
Chris Nolan
Senior InfoSec Manager
NimbusBank

--
Attachment requests: CAIQ export template, SOC 2 copy, example log excerpt
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence request for Redwood Inference

Hi Chris — thanks for the clear list. I'm putting together a small playbook so Nimbus has a deterministic view of our CAIQ answers, owners, and where to retrieve evidence. High level plan: 

1) Deliver an initial CAIQ->CCM registry (spreadsheet) with owner columns and links to artifacts by 2026-07-18.
2) Attach SOC 2 Type II and a curated set of evidence (logs excerpt, policy docs).
3) Flag any controls where we provide compensating controls or where regulatory scope limits evidence sharing; propose mitigations.

Neha (cc'd) will own artifact collection and access gating; she'll coordinate the Drive folder and a short readme describing redaction rules. If Nimbus needs an NDA amendment for log-level artifacts, we can route that through Legal.

Would you prefer a short walkthrough call after we upload the folder or a recorded walkthrough + Q/A thread?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
